purpose: Record lessons from the 2026 official Melbourne Cup weights without altering the frozen 13 September pre-release prediction snapshot.

sources.name: Racing Victoria Handicapping
sources.finding: The Caulfield and Melbourne Cups have a 59kg minimum topweight at handicap release. The Melbourne Cup minimum is 51kg for older horses and 49kg for three-year-olds. Victorian feature-race handicapping also allows horse-specific assessment and handicapper discretion rather than mechanical ratings-to-kilograms conversion.

sources.name: 2025 Lexus Melbourne Cup Race Conditions
sources.finding: The published Cup conditions explicitly separate benchmark weights from minimum handicap weights. They list NH 3YO C&G at 56.5kg and NH 3YO fillies at 55.0kg, while the 3YO minimum handicap weight is 49.0kg. The appended-weight/ballot mechanism is separate again.

sources.name: Racing Victoria 2025 Melbourne Cup weights release
sources.finding: The 2025 official release provides a practical example of the NH 3YO benchmark structure being used in a live Cup handicap and reinforces that elite NH 3YOs need not sit near the 49kg minimum.

historicalConditionsReference.note: These are benchmark weights in the published Cup conditions, not minimum handicap weights and not automatic allocations. The 2026 methodology must use the applicable 2026 race conditions when available.

nh3yoFinding.description: The frozen model conflated the 49kg three-year-old minimum with the much higher NH 3YO benchmark structure. That made the NH 3YO cohort systematically too light. The next model must begin from the applicable Cup benchmark for age/sex and then assess each horse's merit relative to that benchmark, subject to the race-wide scale and handicapper relativities.

methodologyForFutureResearch: Use the applicable Melbourne Cup benchmark table as the structural starting point. Do not use the 49kg three-year-old minimum as an NH 3YO class anchor.
Keep three concepts separate: benchmark weight, actual handicap allocation, and minimum handicap weight. They are not interchangeable.
Estimate each NH 3YO's merit relative to its age/sex benchmark using exposed Group/Listed and open-age form, then position it within the full Cup field relativities.
Model the mandatory minimum-topweight requirement as a race-wide scale constraint rather than embedding the uplift horse-by-horse.
Treat international ratings, WFA relationships, feature-race form and direct horse-to-horse relativities as evidence inputs, not as a mechanical kilograms conversion.
Keep ballot/qualification status separate from handicap merit. Appended ballot figures and race weights serve different purposes.
Keep inactive or non-prospective cases separate from active-contender calibration so they cannot distort model diagnostics.
Validate the revised structure on historical Cup handicaps before prospective use. The 2026 official weights are an audit set, not a training target to fit exactly.

governance.rule: Never overwrite the frozen prediction snapshot. Post-release learning must be versioned separately and tested out-of-sample before promotion.
